notes.summary: The meeting discussed a resolution regarding public transparency and recording restrictions for council meetings. Councilor Miller proposed a resolution to embrace improvements in public transparency, including allowing recordings of public chamber meetings and withdrawing from legal proceedings related to a case challenging these restrictions. The resolution was moved by Councilor Miller and seconded by Councilor Kaczynski. Concerns were raised about the timing of the resolution in relation to an upcoming court case.
